query:
SELECT i.customerId, c.fullName, SUM(i.totalAmount - COALESCE(i.paidAmount, 0)) as unpaidAmount
FROM invoices i
JOIN customers c ON i.customerId = c.id
WHERE i.status != 'paid' OR i.totalAmount > COALESCE(i.paidAmount, 0)
GROUP BY i.customerId
HAVING unpaidAmount > 0
ORDER BY unpaidAmount DESC
LIMIT 20;
